approval.title: Approval and publication
approval.approvedBody: A centre or UNICEF administrator has approved this organisation. New opportunities publish straight away.
approval.pendingBody: New organisations are reviewed by a centre or UNICEF administrator before their opportunities are published.
approval.note: Approval and publication are simulated in this demonstration. No real organisation is verified.

dashboard.title: Employer dashboard
dashboard.body: Your opportunities, applicants and confirmed placements, for your organisation only.

hints.applicants: Submitted applications; drafts are not shown
hints.shortlisted: Reached shortlist, client discussion or acceptance
hints.interviews: Interview or client discussion in progress
hints.placements: Confirmed job starts only; offers are excluded

dashboard.freelanceNote: Completed freelance assignments: {{count}}. These are tracked separately and never counted as placements.

allClear.title: No decisions waiting
allClear.body: Every application has an outcome. New applications will appear here as soon as learners submit them.

noApplicants.title: No applicants yet
noApplicants.body: Publish a clear opportunity: a specific title, the main tasks, required skills, location and a realistic deadline help learners decide whether to apply.

noMatch.title: No matching candidates
noMatch.body: Try adjusting the requirements or filters, or review the skills gap: learners may still be completing the relevant courses.

noOpps.title: No opportunities yet
noOpps.body: Create your first opportunity to start receiving applications from trained learners.

opps.title: Opportunities
opps.body: Create, review and close your organisation's opportunities.
opps.closeBody: Existing applications and outcomes stay available to you and to the learners. New applications will be disabled.
opps.closedNote: Opportunity closed: applications and outcomes are retained, and new applications are disabled.
opps.noneInFilterBody: Choose another filter to see the rest of your opportunities.

form.pageBody: Describe the role or project clearly. Title, scope, deadline and contact are checked before publishing.
form.title: Title
form.descriptionHint: Main tasks, who the learner will work with and what success looks like.
form.questionsHint: Keep questions short and relevant to the role.
form.questionsPh: Why are you interested in this role?
form.compensationHint: Optional. Add only what you can confirm.
form.deliverablesPh: For example: five original posts with short copy
form.reviewPh: For example: one round of review

feeOptions.toAgree: To be agreed with the selected freelancer

form.defaultEvidence: CV or profile and a short motivation answer
form.publishNote: Publication is simulated. The opportunity appears for learners in this demo only.
form.approvalNote: Your organisation is pending approval. The opportunity will publish once a centre or UNICEF administrator approves it.
form.queued: Opportunity saved and waiting for approval

errors.title: Enter a title of at least 4 characters.
errors.description: Describe the scope in at least 20 characters.
errors.deadlinePast: The deadline must be after today.
errors.contact: Enter a valid email address or phone number.
errors.deliverables: List the deliverables for this freelance project.

profile.title: Organisation profile
profile.body: Fictional organisation details shown to learners on your opportunities.
profile.name: Organisation name
profile.nameHint: Use a fictional name in this demonstration.
profile.emailHint: Sample address only. No messages are sent.

errors.name: Enter the organisation name.
errors.description: Add a description of at least 20 characters.

candidates.title: Candidate search
candidates.body: Learners who chose to make their career profile visible to employers.
candidates.privacy: Only opted-in profiles are shown. Assessment answers, disability information, support preferences and private coaching notes are never visible here.
candidates.noSignals: No declared skills or evidence linked to this opportunity yet.

apps.title: Applications
apps.body: Review submitted applications and record each decision. Every change updates the learner's own timeline.
apps.noneInFilter: Change the opportunity or stage filter to see other applications.

detail.privacy: Shown: applicant-approved career evidence only. Assessment answers, disability information, support and coaching notes stay private.
detail.placed: Confirmed job start recorded. It now appears under Placements and on the learner's timeline.

completed.freelance: Delivery completed. Recorded as a freelance assignment, not as employment.
completed.enterprise: Clinic completed. Recorded as an enterprise milestone, not as a placement.

hints.submitted: New application. Start a review when you are ready.
hints.underReview: Review the evidence, then shortlist or record a respectful Not selected decision.
hints.interview: After the interview, record an offer or a Not selected decision.
hints.offer: An offer is not a placement. Confirm the job start once the start date is agreed.
hints.clientDiscussion: After the discussion, select the freelancer or record a Not selected decision.
hints.selected: Selection is not completed work. Confirm when delivery starts.
hints.inDelivery: Mark the assignment completed when the agreed deliverables are received.
hints.review: Review the business concept, then accept or record a Not selected decision.
hints.accepted: Confirm when the learner starts participating. No funding is offered.
hints.participating: Mark completed when the clinic ends.

move.feeHint: Illustrative only. No payment is processed.
move.bodyGeneric: Record this step. The learner sees it on their application timeline.

body.interview: Record the interview date. The learner is notified in the app only.
body.clientDiscussion: Record the client discussion. The learner is notified in the app only.
body.hired: Confirm the job start with start date, role and work type. This creates a confirmed placement.
body.selected: Record the selection. Selection is tracked separately from completed work.
body.completed: Record completion. This is tracked separately from employment.

move.doneGeneric: Stage updated on the learner's timeline

done.offer: Offer recorded. Not counted as a placement yet
done.hired: Job start confirmed and added to placements

notSelected.title: Record Not selected
notSelected.body: Your feedback goes only to this applicant. No other applicants are named or compared.
notSelected.label: Feedback for the applicant
notSelected.hint: Be specific and kind. Mention one strength and one area to develop.
notSelected.template: Thank you, {{name}}, for applying and for the time you gave to this process. We are not able to offer you this opportunity on this occasion. Your application showed clear motivation. To strengthen future applications, we suggest adding one specific example of your work to your CV or portfolio. We encourage you to keep applying.
notSelected.error: Add feedback of at least 20 characters.
notSelected.done: Decision recorded with feedback. The learner keeps access to learning and career support.

placements.title: Placements and feedback
placements.body: Confirmed outcomes for your opportunities and your feedback on workforce needs.
placements.rule: Only confirmed job starts count as placements. Offers awaiting a confirmed start: {{count}}. Freelance selection and enterprise acceptance are tracked separately.
placements.freelanceNote: Selection, completed work and any sample fee are recorded separately. No payment is processed.

empty.title: No confirmed placements yet
empty.body: When you confirm a job start on an application, it appears here. Offers alone are not placements.

freelanceEmpty.title: No freelance assignments yet
freelanceEmpty.body: Select a freelancer from a client discussion to start tracking the assignment.

enterpriseEmpty.title: No enterprise milestones yet
enterpriseEmpty.body: Accept an applicant into the clinic to begin tracking participation and completion.

feedback.title: Workforce feedback
feedback.body: Your answers are combined with other employers' feedback in aggregate reports. Do not include names.
feedback.strengthsPh: For example: punctual, friendly with customers
feedback.needsPh: For example: two customer service roles in spring
feedback.error: Add at least one answer before submitting.
